positions.title: Data Architect
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in transforming data architecture, resulting in improved data accessibility and reporting.  

• Developed and documented data models for AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MS SQL Server, ensuring compliance with standards.  
• Created database views and functions that facilitated seamless data migration and enhanced UI dashboard performance.  
• Worked with cross-functional teams to drive business reporting requirements, leading to better insights into functional KPIs.

positions.title: Data Architect I
positions.description:
I successfully contributed to the data architecture at Assurant Employee Benefits by implementing key DDL changes and developing robust data models.  

• Executed DDL changes in Oracle environments to streamline project-related tasks and improve efficiency.  
• Created detailed logical and physical data models, enhancing data organization and retrieval for operational systems.  
• Documented all data model elements to ensure adherence to company standards, fostering a culture of compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Architects · Data Modeling · Data Warehousing · Oracle SQL · ER/Studio

positions.title: Data Architect / Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Data Architect with the following responsibilities:
Development of logical and physical data models, from small changes to large development projects, for the ODS using ER Studio Data Architect and PowerDesigner targeting DB2 and Oracle databases.
Development of logical and physical data models for new and existing Data Marts and Data Warehouse using ER Studio Data Architect and PowerDesigner targeting the UDB database.
Naming and fully documenting data model tables and columns to ensure compliance with in-house standards.
Development of database triggers on ODS tables to meet business and auditing requirements.
Primary IT representative on business-led Data Management Council (DMC) to ensure that new data requests reviewed by business partners will meet the rigor of IT standards while promoting data quality and to help the business understand the system impacts to of existing and changed data elements.
Working face-to-face with business partners in developing logical and physical data models that meet current and future business needs.
Working with onshore and offshore technical staff in the development of logical and physical data model changes.
Review SQL queries from application developers on project teams and write complex SQL queries for project teams as needed.
Work closely with database administrators (DBAs) in implementing solutions that require special attention such as preventing or eliminating performance issues, database partitioning, and database triggers.
COOL:Gen developer of GUI, block mode and Internet servers of internal and customer-facing applications targeting Windows and MVS/DB2 platforms.
COOL:Gen model manager, and Central Encyclopedia administrator. 
Technical Lead responsible for upgrading COOL:Gen software.
Technical lead responsible writing COOL:Gen development specifications for other developers.
Technical lead for implementation of SunGard Client/Server application.
OmniVBA script developer used in SunGard OmniStation application.
